info.name: Kitchen Margin Tracker API
info.description:
All REST endpoints of the Kitchen Margin Tracker backend (Express + MongoDB).

Run the whole collection in order (Collection Runner) against a running backend. Each run registers a fresh owner using `runId`, adds a manager, exercises every route with tests, then cleans up.

request.description: Managers can only be added by an owner from the Team page.
Saves the JWT into the `token` collection variable; later requests send it as a Bearer token.
